records.title: process_job recover branch lacks status whitelist
records.disposition_rationale: Peer actions already whitelist statuses; recover omission is a dispatcher code gap, not a docs misread.
records.divergence_description: Recover executes without an explicit status conjunct required by REQ-002.
records.documented_intent: Recover only for queued|retrying|restoring.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py:2223-2224 bare recover branch calls process_recover.
records.proposed_fix: Add status conjunct matching selection set.
records.reachability_analysis: Searched process_jobs_once selection filter and peer action status conjuncts; selection is not a substitute for dispatcher whitelist — stale job dict still reaches recover.

records.title: Reversible cloud hide skips concurrent VersionId detection
records.disposition_rationale: Scheduled provider_version_id is loaded but unused for compare; S3 delete-marker mechanics do not preclude Head/compare.
records.divergence_description: Unversioned delete hides current without detecting scheduled≠current.
records.documented_intent: Abort or audit when current generation ≠ scheduled Archive Version.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py:2099-2102 delete_object without Head compare; rename 1622-1625 same class.
records.proposed_fix: Head current VersionId and abort on mismatch before marker.
records.reachability_analysis: Searched for HeadObject/VersionId compare before delete_object in process_cloud_archive and process_rename; provider_version_id loaded but unused; one-active-file job gate is mitigation not prevention.

records.title: csrf_token_for ignores session_version force-logout
records.disposition_rationale: resolve_session already enforces session_version; CSRF layer omission is a concrete code parity gap.
records.divergence_description: Force-logout does not invalidate CSRF token lookup.
records.documented_intent: CSRF lookup returns None when session_version diverges.
records.code_behavior: sessions.py:115-137 omits session_version compare.
records.proposed_fix: Join users and compare session_version in csrf_token_for.
records.reachability_analysis: Compared csrf_token_for against resolve_session session_version join; resolve_session enforces, csrf path omits — force-logout compensation incomplete.

records.title: README Users overclaims operator free-space
records.disposition_rationale: Code/tests correctly enforce owner-only; README Users wording is the compensation failure.
records.divergence_description: Users section advertises operator free-space contrary to authoritative code.
records.documented_intent: Only primary owner may free local space.
records.code_behavior: main.py:2451 is_owner gate; README.md:19-20 overclaim.
records.proposed_fix: Edit README Users bullet to exclude free-space from operator capabilities.
records.reachability_analysis: Compared README Users vs is_owner free-space gate and tests; code/tests authoritative.

records.title: Startup cleanup destroys free-space claim files before reconcile
records.disposition_rationale: REQ-009 claim/salvage invariant is voided when startup unlinks .cleanup-*.tmp before reconcile marks missing paths completed.
records.divergence_description: Free-space salvage claims deleted at process start; Job completed as freed.
records.documented_intent: Interrupted free-space must restore Local Copy or preserve salvage claim path.
records.code_behavior: storage.py:1028 unlinks is_restore_temporary_name including CLEANUP; main.py:160 before reconcile; 1092-1109 completes without restore.
records.proposed_fix: Exclude CLEANUP temps from abandoned-restore cleanup; reconcile restores claims before complete.
records.reachability_analysis: Traced lifespan cleanup_abandoned_restore_files before reconcile; is_restore_temporary_name includes CLEANUP_TEMPORARY_RE; no upstream restore_claimed_local_copy before unlink.

records.title: Operating windows compared as lexicographic strings
records.disposition_rationale: HTTP allows non-padded HH:MM (len 4-5); string compare accepts inverted 10:00-9:30 and rejects valid 9:30-10:00.
records.divergence_description: REQ-012 start>end rejection fails for non-padded stamps.
records.documented_intent: start > end must raise ValueError; valid start < end accepted.
records.code_behavior: operation_policies.py:96-97 compares raw strings after int shape parse.
records.proposed_fix: Compare parsed (hour, minute) tuples.
records.reachability_analysis: Checked _normalize_windows for parsed time compare; only lexicographic start>=end; HTTP allows len 4–5 so non-padded values reach comparator.

records.title: Cloud scan forks Vault File identity after rename
records.disposition_rationale: CONTEXT Path History identity must survive renames; scan minting orphans is a code gap.
records.divergence_description: record_archive_version creates Vault File before object_key dedupe; current-path-only lookup.
records.documented_intent: One Vault File identity across Path History.
records.code_behavior: catalog.py record_archive_version calls _get_or_create_file first.
records.proposed_fix: Lookup existing archive_versions first; _resolve_cloud_path_file for historical paths.
records.reachability_analysis: Checked archive_versions object_key dedupe order vs _get_or_create_file; create precedes dedupe; historical Path History not consulted; confirm_file_rename correctly closes paths.

records.title: Rename audit_log omits connection
records.disposition_rationale: audit_log persistence contract requires connection inside db transactions.
records.divergence_description: Rename mutations are log-only.
records.documented_intent: Durable audit_events for Path History changes.
records.code_behavior: main.py confirm_rename audit_log without connection.
records.proposed_fix: Pass connection to audit_log.
records.reachability_analysis: Checked audit_log callers in confirm_rename/folder/auto-rename inside db(); connection omitted; /api/audit-events reads only durable rows.

records.title: Configured S3 backup failure silent local-only success
records.disposition_rationale: Configured off-host backup must fail closed per metadata-backups docs.
records.divergence_description: except Exception return None.
records.documented_intent: local + S3 when configured.
records.code_behavior: default_object_store returns None on client errors.
records.proposed_fix: Raise BackupError when bucket configured.
records.reachability_analysis: Checked default_object_store except path; bucket-set failures return None identical to unset; run_metadata_backup treats None as success; docs require S3 when configured.

records.title: OIDC callback switches session on foreign linked identity
records.disposition_rationale: ADR-0003/0005 forbid silent account switch during self-link/step-up.
records.divergence_description: else create_session for other user_id.
records.documented_intent: Reject cross-account while logged in.
records.code_behavior: main.py oidc callback else-branch session mint.
records.proposed_fix: elif existing user != user_id: HTTP 403.
records.reachability_analysis: Checked oidc callback session branch vs ADR-0003/0005; _resolve_or_bind_identity returns foreign user before invite redeem; else create_session switches account; no sign-out guard.

records.title: Recover overwrites on-disk Local Copy when catalog says absent
records.disposition_rationale: Catalog presence lag must not authorize silent Path.replace overwrite of an existing file.
records.divergence_description: process_recover checks catalog only then replace() without lexists.
records.documented_intent: Restore missing Local Copy without destroying existing on-disk content.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py process_recover replace without destination existence check.
records.proposed_fix: Refuse when os.path.lexists(destination).
records.reachability_analysis: Free-space then external recreate before rescan reaches recover with local_presence!=present.

records.title: Crypt recover ignores Archive Version object_key
records.disposition_rationale: REQ-001 crypt surface must preserve Archive Version identity after rename; object_key is loaded then ignored.
records.divergence_description: Crypt rclone uses job path; boto3 uses object_key.
records.documented_intent: Exact VersionId recovery addresses the stored Archive Version key.
records.code_behavior: download_exact_version_plaintext crypt branch job['path'] only.
records.proposed_fix: object_key_to_path for crypt destinations.
records.reachability_analysis: Post-rename recover of historical Archive Version on crypt vault.

records.title: User reactivation omits session_version bump
records.disposition_rationale: Same revocation axis as force-logout/password change; reactivation must not revive pre-deactivation cookies.
records.divergence_description: active updates omit session_version bump.
records.documented_intent: Deactivate/reactivate invalidates existing Sessions.
records.code_behavior: update_user only bumps version on password change.
records.proposed_fix: Bump session_version when active is set.
records.reachability_analysis: Admin deactivate then reactivate; old cookie still resolves.

records.title: Restore estimate vs worker price-book skew
records.disposition_rationale: Operators act on estimate API; irreversible RestoreObject holds must use the same active price book.
records.divergence_description: estimate API uses price book; process_recover uses DEFAULT rates.
records.documented_intent: High-impact gating consistent with configured rates.
records.code_behavior: estimate_restore without pricing= from get_active_price_book.
records.proposed_fix: Pass book.restore_rates into estimate_restore.
records.reachability_analysis: Activate custom cost_price_books row then compare estimate high_impact vs worker hold.

records.title: Metadata verify stamps a different run than the artifact checked
records.disposition_rationale: Verify path unbound from run digest/path while download binding already exists.
records.divergence_description: artifacts[0] verified then newest succeeded id stamped without join.
records.documented_intent: Verified status attaches to the restore-tested artifact/run.
records.code_behavior: app/storage.py:_verify_latest_metadata_backup_once uses unbound newest file + newest succeeded id.
records.proposed_fix: Select artifact from run local_path/digest; UPDATE that id.
records.reachability_analysis: Scheduled verify interval >0; orphan newer .bak.enc or reordered runs reachable.

records.title: Cloud-archive fail-closes on observability after Delete Marker
records.disposition_rationale: Parity with local cleanup best-effort observability after non-idempotent S3 hide.
records.divergence_description: Unguarded notify in record_archive_completed can roll back marker txn / fail job → retry delete_object.
records.documented_intent: Post-Delete-Marker observability must not re-queue another hide.
records.code_behavior: cloud_deletion.record_archive_completed bare _notify_vault_owners.
records.proposed_fix: try/except best-effort notify + worker_error.
records.reachability_analysis: Notification enqueue failure after successful delete_object.

records.title: Cancel recover clears restore_state after non-cancellable RestoreObject
records.disposition_rationale: Worker documents RestoreObject cannot be cancelled; cancel still NULLs restore_state.
records.divergence_description: clear_restore_state_for_jobs on recover cancel vs update_restore_state after restore_object.
records.documented_intent: Retain restore_state/expiry for subsequent recover polling.
records.code_behavior: app/main.py cancel recover clears restore_state.
records.proposed_fix: Remove clear_restore_state_for_jobs from cancel recover path.
records.reachability_analysis: User cancels recover while status restoring after AWS accepted RestoreObject.

records.title: Temp-database metadata verify reports success without proven schema
records.disposition_rationale: Distinct from rejected list-only former-003; temp_database mode returns ok:True with null counts after createdb succeeded.
records.divergence_description: Isolated PG verify ok without proven users/vaults/alembic counts.
records.documented_intent: Verification restores into isolated temp DB and proves schema.
records.code_behavior: metadata_backups.py:458-500 returns ok:True with null counts under temp_database.
records.proposed_fix: Raise BackupError when counts remain null in temp_database mode.
records.reachability_analysis: Mocked subprocess probe: createdb ok, restore rc=1, psql fail → ok:True today.

records.title: Last-admin deactivation check races the UPDATE
records.disposition_rationale: Invariant stated in-handler; check and UPDATE are separate transactions without conditional WHERE.
records.divergence_description: Concurrent admin deactivate can yield zero active admins.
records.documented_intent: At least one administrator must remain active.
records.code_behavior: main.py:2670-2700 separate with db() blocks; UPDATE unconditional.
records.proposed_fix: FOR UPDATE + conditional last-admin WHERE in same transaction.
records.reachability_analysis: Structural TOCTOU; SQLite may serialize but predicate still missing.

records.title: OIDC self-link invite creation skips recent reauth
records.disposition_rationale: ADR-0005 lists invite creation as sensitive; ADR-0003 self-link is invite issuance; admin path already gates.
records.divergence_description: oidc_link create_invite without require_recent_reauth.
records.documented_intent: Invite creation requires reauth_at within window.
records.code_behavior: main.py:1079-1096 Depends(current_user) only.
records.proposed_fix: Add require_recent_reauth + prompt=login on begin_login.
records.reachability_analysis: Compared to admin invites Depends(require_recent_reauth) at 2643-2648.

records.title: Invite redeem UPDATE is not single-use under concurrency
records.disposition_rationale: ADR-0003 single-use; UPDATE by id only after non-locking SELECT.
records.divergence_description: Concurrent redeem can bind multiple subjects / clobber redeemer fields.
records.documented_intent: Invites are single-use.
records.code_behavior: invites.py:99-106 UPDATE WHERE id=%s only.
records.proposed_fix: WHERE id=%s AND redeemed_at IS NULL + rowcount check.
records.reachability_analysis: No FOR UPDATE / conditional UPDATE; UNIQUE only on (issuer,subject).
